test_name: Audit and Accountability - AU-2 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Case-Management-030
Primary NIST family: Audit and Accountability (AU); evidence focus: AU-2.
Environment: GCP. Network access uses Private Service Connect; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Cloud KMS key. Control evidence: one low-risk application log source can arrive in the SIEM up to two hours late, while central audit logging remains enabled. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
